Apocalips's unique: the Apocalypse Cannon. All the damage of your basic attack is stored as energy, and every attack charges the cannon: 8 levels, each one asking more attacks than the last (the bar under your feet). F fires it: a beam that crosses the whole map, wider with your area, and unloads all the energy on every monster it touches: x1 at level 1, up to x10 at level 8. The energy has no limit.
Archers and gunslingers change their ammo type with E / R (or by clicking the Quiver).
Baphomet's unique: your basic attack reaps in a crescent around you, and every 7 hits the Demon Lord's scythe falls on everyone around you and heals you for each one ×Lv.
Basic attack: +0.5 ranged reach per upgrade level; in melee, a little more reach and its wide swing reaches farther. At max: +3 ranged.
Beelzebub's unique: the Lord of the Flies lends you his swarm. 4 Hunter Flies circle around you, dart at nearby monsters and drain their life for you ×Lv.
Blessing of Asgard: enemies have +60% HP and +10% damage, and can't be knocked back
Click what you want · if several want it, dice
Crafts every elemental arrow for the quiver and lets you switch them in combat with E / R. With an elemental arrow, +5% damage per level to everything you shoot (basic attack and arrow skills).
Eddga's unique: the tiger's Endure. Every hit you take wakes its fury: +35% speed, +35% attack speed and +15% damage for 4 s, with a roar that strikes around you.
Eternal Frost: the frozen ground is slippery!

Fallen Bishop's unique: every heal you receive bursts into holy light (Holy, at most once per second): it hurts nearby monsters for three times what was healed, more so undead and demons, and grows with your skill damage and area. It doesn't depend on Holy Light. Every 3.5 s the bishop prays for you and heals you 4% HP.
He switched blades! The floor is going to freeze!

Ifrit's unique: the volcano beats with your spells. Every skill you cast stokes its Heat (the embers circling you); at 12, Ifrit erupts: a column of lava razes and burns everything around you, the ground keeps burning for 4 s and, for 6 s, your skills recharge 50% faster ×Lv.
In Options > Graphics lower the "Amount of effects" or the opacity of your effects (also from the pause menu). With lots of monsters and skills on screen, that helps the most.
Infinite %s ammo. Switch with E / R.
Legendary: Heal also smites: a burst of holy light damages the monsters around you (far more to undead and demons) and it casts even at full HP.
Legendary: against a lone target (an MVP) Back Stab keeps stabbing it, blinking from side to side: 5 stabs plus 1 per Back Stab upgrade.
Legendary: all your buffs are 50% stronger (Blessing, Adrenaline Rush...).

Lord Knight Seyren's unique: the blade of Lighthalzen's experiments. Every 1.5 s a lab clone fights for you with its skill: Bowling Bash, Sonic Blow, Cart Termination, Heal, Sharp Shooting or Storm Gust ×Lv.
Mistress's unique: ×1.25 Wind damage, and any hit of yours (basic attack, skill or proc) sometimes releases a lightning bolt that leaps between 5 monsters (very often if it is Wind) ×Lv.
